subject_line: An Author Spotlight for Stolen Hope
email_body:
Hi Zoe,

I noticed that Stolen Hope opened your Dragonfly Creek series this May, taking you from the small towns of Pine Harbour to a cowboy romance world, and that book two, Lucky Haven, followed in September. It is exciting to see a long-running series author start something new.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author. Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

While looking at where Stolen Hope appears online, I could not find a book trailer or short promotional reel for the series. A cinematic trailer and a few reels could give new readers a quick way into Dragonfly Creek. This is entirely optional and separate from the Spotlight, and the Spotlight stands on its own either way.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit Stolen Hope best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
The Author Ledger
